description: A without-elision-except method in a feature condition fails during loading (engine §13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.without-elision-except(text).value = "a"
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A
```
